text: Aurelius completed its acquisition of FIAMM Energy Technology from Japan's Resonac Corporation on 1 December 2025, taking over all employees and business activities.
short: FIAMM Energy Technology is owned by AURELIUS private equity since December 2025

source.name: FIAMM press release (fiamm.com): completion of the acquisition by Aurelius
source.quote: Aurelius has successfully completed the acquisition of FIAMM Energy Technology from Resonac Corporation
